advise_catalyst.text: You feel most like yourself when your effort has a name and an end. Tell someone the date you will finish and let them hold you to it. Plan one dinner this month, from the guest list to the bill. Sign up for one class that ends in a test. Make your bed.

Make your bed.

advise_friction.text: Seek Fire, the Mind energy. Fire is light and warmth the ground takes in, so pressure turns into understanding. Let it soften what Wood presses on you. You meet every demand as if your standing hangs on it. Read one page on why the rule exists before you answer it. Sit in the sun a while.

advise_catalyst.text: Your Mind grows on warmth, and warmth is something you have to go and sit near. Once a month go to a class or a talk just to take it in. Keep one person you can ask the simple question, and ask it. Read one slow chapter before sleep each night.

Read one slow chapter before sleep each night.

advise_friction.text: Seek Water, the Action energy. Water runs down, cools what it touches and carries it away. Let it spend what Fire burns. You have taken in more than you will ever use, and it sits in you unspent. Decide one open question by a date. Fix one small thing at home with what you already know.

advise_catalyst.text: Most of what you give up, you give up tired. Wait for the whole answer before you agree to anything. Ask one peer to hold the line with you for a week. Keep one routine that survives a bad month. Say yes sitting down.

advise_friction.text: Seek Wood, the Order energy. Wood pushes up through packed soil and reaches for a height it has to earn. Let it shape what Earth stores. You hold your ground even where giving way would cost you nothing. Hand one decision to someone above you. Put one plan up for review before you start it.

advise_catalyst.text: Your Action grows when it has somewhere to go and something to bring back. Put one plan into motion this season, a trip booked or a small venture opened with money you can spare. Say yes to one invitation before you have checked the cost. Call home once a month.

advise_friction.text: Seek Earth, your own Body energy. Earth is the bank and the bed, the ground that keeps water to one course. Let it hold what Water pours. With this much flowing through, little of it ever feels truly yours. Sleep before you say yes to anything new. Eat one meal a day sitting down, with nothing open.
